C0184.title: Nine Defendants Sentenced for Paid Negative Review Deletion Services
C0184.summary: In June 2024, China Court reported a case heard by Kaihua County People’s Court in Zhejiang. Lin and eight other defendants provided paid negative-review deletion services by exploiting platform procedures and falsifying buyer consent evidence, disrupting online review mechanisms and market order. The court convicted the nine defendants of illegal business operations, sentenced them to prison terms from five years to six months, and imposed fines ranging from 300,000 yuan to 23,000 yuan.
